claim: apps/web/src/lib/build-provenance.ts exports a Vite plugin (buildProvenancePlugin) whose transformIndexHtml returns a <meta name="mudavym:commit"> tag (attrs name COMMIT_META_NAME = 'mudavym:commit', content = the resolved commit), resolving the value from CANDIDATE_VARS in the order VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA, RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA, then `git rev-parse HEAD`, else the literal UNKNOWN_COMMIT = 'unknown' (never an empty string); apps/web/vite.config.ts lists buildProvenancePlugin() as an unconditional element of its plugins array, and the plugin carries no `apply:` (which would limit it to dev or build). apps/web/turbo.json extends the root config and declares VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA and RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA in the build task's env, so turbo hashes every commit differently: without it, turbo's cache replays an earlier build's dist/ and its tag (measured 2026-09-22 with a scratch --cache-dir: the second of two builds was a cache hit naming the first commit). Behavioural proof, not re-run by this row: build-provenance.test.ts (9 cases) and two real `vite build` runs on 2026-09-22 that found the tag exactly once in dist/index.html, dist/crawl/app.html, dist/crawl/heads/*.html and dist/404.html, outside the <!-- seo:head:start -->...<!-- seo:head:end --> block ADR 0158 owns

claim: scripts/check_web_deployed_sha.py's DEFAULT_PATHS (the one list deploy.yml uses both for the FLOOR it records and for the check) covers every file a non-test source file under apps/web or packages/ui reaches by relative import, followed transitively, and every listed path exists: today that is apps/web, packages/ui, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml, package.json, turbo.json, and the two gateway files the bundle imports (ReceivingWorkspace.tsx -> apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/price-currency.ts -> apps/api-gateway/src/common/iso-4217.ts). A file left out lets a stale build that lacks it pass as UNCHANGED; the list the first draft of this ADR shipped missed both gateway files, and --check-paths names both when run against it

scripts/check_web_deployed_sha.py --self-test exits 0 on every pull request, not only after a merge in deploy.yml Stage 3: against a throwaway git repo, a clone of it and a real localhost HTTP server it reaches all nine states (MATCH, UNCHANGED, SUPERSEDED, STALE, PAGE_MALFORMED, NETWORK_UNREACHABLE, UNKNOWN_MARKER, DIVERGENT, CANNOT_RESOLVE), including the tip refresh, and runs the CLI end to end so main()'s exit code is what is asserted (MATCH 0, STALE 1, PAGE_MALFORMED 2, UNKNOWN_MARKER 3, DIVERGENT 4).
